entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez came close
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 1-for-1 with 1 BB against Grayson Rodriguez and the Los Angeles Angels. Closest call was a double in the 3rd: "Yordan Alvarez hits a ground-rule double (26) on a fly ball down the left-field line." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Alec Burleson stayed in the yard
entries.story: Alec Burleson went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Brady Singer and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Mike Trout stayed in the yard
entries.story: Mike Trout went 0-for-3 with 2 BB against Peter Lambert and the Houston Astros. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.
